name: blogs
description: A two-package blog: an Express + Prisma API and a React reading client.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @blogs/server" "npm run start -w @blogs/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @blogs/server && npm run build -w @blogs/web
scripts.setup: npm run prisma:generate -w @blogs/server && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @blogs/server && npm run lint -w @blogs/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @blogs/server && npm run typecheck -w @blogs/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @blogs/server && npm run test -w @blogs/web
